signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to your library.
signIn.identifierHint: Staff sign in with the username your admin gave you (e.g. staff_3).
firstLogin.title: Set up your account
firstLogin.subtitle: Choose a new password before you start. The temporary one your administrator gave you stops working once you do.
firstLogin.name: Your name
firstLogin.pwHint: At least 12 characters. It cannot be the temporary password you were given.
signUp.title: Create your library
signUp.subtitle: Set up Libriant for your library in a few minutes.
signUp.libraryNameHint: How your library will be displayed across the app.
signUp.librarySlugHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. Your library will live at app.libriant.com/t/your-library.
signUp.passwordHint: At least 12 characters. We recommend a passphrase.
errors.invalidCredentials: We couldn't sign you in with those details. Please check your email and password.
errors.libraryNameRequired: Please give your library a name.
errors.slugInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens. It must start and end with a letter or digit.
errors.somethingWentWrong: Something went wrong. Please try again — and if it keeps happening, get in touch.
verifyEmail.heading: Verify your email
verifyEmail.missingToken: This link is missing its confirmation code.
verifyEmail.failedHelp: The link may have expired or already been used. Sign in and send yourself a new one from the reminder in your library — or write to us and we'll confirm the address for you.
verifyEmail.doneSignup: Your email is verified — thank you!
verifyEmail.doneChange: Your new email address is confirmed.
verifyEmail.banner.title: Confirm your email address.
verifyEmail.banner.body: We've sent a confirmation link to {email}. A few actions — inviting staff, for one — stay locked until you confirm it.
verifyEmail.banner.bodyNoEmail: We've sent a confirmation link to your address. A few actions — inviting staff, for one — stay locked until you confirm it.
verifyEmail.banner.fallback: If nothing arrives, check your spam folder — or write to us and we'll confirm the address for you.
verifyEmail.banner.resentToast: A new confirmation link is on its way to {email}.
verifyEmail.banner.resentToastNoEmail: A new confirmation link is on its way.
resetPassword.heading: Choose a new password
resetPassword.subtitle: This link works once, and only for an hour after it was issued.
resetPassword.newPasswordHint: At least {min} characters. Three or four unrelated words are easy to remember and hard to guess.
resetPassword.done: Your password is set. You can sign in with it now.
resetPassword.expired: This reset link has already been used, or it has expired. Ask for a new one.
resetPassword.help.title: How to get a reset link
resetPassword.help.staff: If you sign in with a username your library gave you (like staff_3), the person who runs the library can set a new password for you from the Staff page — it appears on their screen straight away.
resetPassword.help.owner: If you set the library up yourself, write to Libriant support from the address you sign in with, or call us. We will give you a one-time link that works for 60 minutes.
